name: list_browser_targets
description: List page targets exposed by the selected loopback Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint. Optionally filter by exact origin. URLs preserve query values and fragments; only URL userinfo credentials are removed.

cdp_endpoint.description: Literal loopback CDP endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:PORT, or ws://127.0.0.1:PORT/devtools/browser/ID.

__schema0.description: Literal loopback CDP endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:PORT, or ws://127.0.0.1:PORT/devtools/browser/ID.
